nodes.summary: For natural numbers $m$, $r$, $j$ and $k$, the entry with zero-based index $k$ in row $j$ of the Connell $(m, r)$ triangle is $s_j + mk$, where $s_j$ is the first entry of row $j$. The formula is used for every $k$, also at or beyond the row length.
nodes.title: Entries of the Connell triangle

nodes.summary: For a natural number $r$, the position following row $j$, zero-based column $k$, is row $j$, column $k + 1$ if $k + 1 < 1 + r(j - 1)$ (the length of row $j$, with $j - 1$ read as $0$ when $j = 0$), and row $j + 1$, column $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Next position in the Connell triangle

nodes.summary: A pair of natural numbers $(m, r)$ with $m \ge 2$ and $r \ge 1$; these are the admissible parameters of a Connell $(m, r)$ sequence.
nodes.title: Connell parameters

nodes.summary: For a natural number $r$, the position $p_n = (j_n, k_n)$ (row $j_n$, zero-based column $k_n$) of index $n \ge 0$ is defined by $p_0 = (1, 0)$ and $p_{n+1} = (j_n, k_n + 1)$ if $k_n + 1 < 1 + r(j_n - 1)$ (the length of row $j_n$, with $j_n - 1$ read as $0$ when $j_n = 0$), and $p_{n+1} = (j_n + 1, 0)$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Position of a term in the Connell triangle

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $m$, $r$ and $j$, row $j$ of the Connell $(m, r)$ triangle is the finite set of the numbers $s_j + mk$ with $0 \le k < \ell_j$, where $s_j$ is the first entry of row $j$ and $\ell_j = 1 + r(j - 1)$ is its length, with $j - 1$ read as $0$ when $j = 0$.
nodes.title: Rows of the Connell triangle

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $r$ and $j$, the length of row $j$ is $1 + r(j - 1)$, where $j - 1$ is read as $0$ when $j = 0$. For $j \ge 1$ this is the number of entries in row $j$ of the Connell $(m, r)$ triangle for every $m$; the source numbers rows from one, and the value at $j = 0$ is a convention.
nodes.title: Row lengths of the Connell triangle

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $m$ and $r$, the numbers $s_j$ are defined by $s_0 = s_1 = 1$ and $s_{j+1} = s_j + m(\ell_j - 1) + 1$ for $j \ge 1$, where $\ell_j = 1 + r(j - 1)$ is the length of row $j$. For $j \ge 1$, $s_j$ is the first entry of row $j$ of the Connell $(m, r)$ triangle: each row starts one above the last entry $s_j + m(\ell_j - 1)$ of the row before. The source numbers rows from one, and the value $s_0 = 1$…
nodes.title: First entries of the rows of the Connell triangle

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $m \ge 2$ and $r \ge 1$, the Connell $(m, r)$ sequence $(a_n)_{n \ge 0}$ reads the Connell triangle row by row: row $j \ge 1$ has $\ell_j = 1 + r(j - 1)$ entries $s_j, s_j + m, \dots, s_j + m(\ell_j - 1)$, where $s_1 = 1$ and $s_{j+1} = s_j + m(\ell_j - 1) + 1$. Thus $a_n = s_j + mk$, where row $j$, zero-based column $k$ is the position reached from row $1$, column $0$ after $n$ steps, each step…
nodes.title: Connell sequence

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
